review_scope: Incremental exact-hash successor to the v0.3 physical-site review, adding two cross-source community-mapped campus locators without modifying inherited acceptances or frozen releases.

acceptances.precision_scope: The frozen global-open-v3 Polygon is a reviewed named ICE02 campus fence/site locator inherited by the phase-two project through the explicit project_targets relationship. It is not an official, cadastral, or survey boundary; a complete current campus extent; a building footprint; or a Phase 2 footprint.
acceptances.decision_basis: The Mannverk construction source explicitly identifies atNorth ICE02 Phase 2 in Reykjanesbær and links it to the ICE02 campus. The closed bridge pins the OSM object named ICE02 Campus with operator atNorth in Iceland, while rejecting lifecycle, capacity, imagery, and phase-footprint inference.

acceptances.precision_scope: Contributor-mapped polygon for one named QScale data-centre building at Q01's exact first-party address, used only to locate the Q01 campus. It is not the Building B footprint or centroid, the Q01 campus boundary, a parcel, a construction extent, or a survey-accuracy claim.
acceptances.decision_basis: The v97 project explicitly targets Q01; QScale's captured first-party contact page labels the exact OSM-tagged address as Headquarters - Q01 Campus; and the OSM feature is named QScale with the same house number, street, and postal code.
